RE/MAX Vanderhoof

Discover the possibilities with this 55.69-acre treed property offering privacy, natural beauty, and exciting development potential. Zoned H1, the land allows for subdivision into 4.94-acre parcels, creating an excellent opportunity for investment, recreation, or building your dream rural retreat. Surrounded by Northern BC wilderness, this property places you minutes from the renowned Stellako River and the stunning waters of Francois Lake, both celebrated for exceptional fishing and outdoor adventure. Hunting, boating, and endless recreation await right outside your door. Located just 10 minutes from the welcoming community of Fraser Lake, you'll enjoy the perfect balance of peaceful country living and convenient access to town amenities.
